en.name: Puzzlemaster
en.ability: 1 player is drunk, even if you die. If you guess (once) who it is, learn the Demon player, but guess wrong & get false info.

revisions.v1: 1 player is drunk, even if you die. If you guess (once) who it is, learn the Demon player, but guess wrong & get false info.

zh.name: 解谜大师
zh.ability: 一名玩家醉酒，即使你已死亡。每局游戏限一次，你可以猜测谁是那个醉酒的玩家，如果猜对了，你会得知谁是恶魔，但如果猜错了，你会得知错误的“谁是恶魔”信息。
